title: Polski krok po kroku source content records
description: JSONL files share stable lesson and exercise IDs; item-level workbook records retain source scans, normalized Polish prompts and answers, audio links, and explicit QA status.

common_fields.source_id: stable source page identifier such as workbook-pdf-p102
common_fields.text: verbatim extracted page text, not assumed corrected

files.workbook-key-pages.jsonl: one record per workbook answer-key scan page
files.workbook-answer-index.jsonl: one lesson record containing exercise-to-key-page locators
files.workbook-audio-exercises.jsonl: one record per workbook audio asset
files.teacher-lessons.jsonl: one record per teacher-guide lesson section
files.workbook-exercise-index.jsonl: Global exercise index with content_record_ref links for item-level lesson 1–5 records.
files.coursebook-exercises.jsonl: exercise blocks extracted from the searchable coursebook PDF and teacher-guide lesson references
files.workbook-scan-compare.jsonl: second-pass scan OCR and page agreement flags for workbook
files.teacher-scan-compare.jsonl: second-pass scan OCR and page agreement flags for teacher-guide lesson pages
files.workbook-lesson01-content.jsonl: Item-level transcribed and scan-checked prompt/answer records for lesson 1 (16 exercises).
files.workbook-lesson02-content.jsonl: Item-level transcribed and scan-checked prompt/answer records for lesson 2 (18 exercises); L02/E04 retains a printed-key morphology anomaly flag.
files.workbook-lesson03-content.jsonl: Item-level transcribed and scan-checked prompt/answer records for lesson 3 (14 exercises).
files.workbook-lesson04-content.jsonl: Item-level transcribed and scan-checked prompt/answer records for lesson 4 (15 exercises).
files.workbook-lesson05-content.jsonl: Item-level transcribed and scan-checked prompt/answer records for lesson 5 (17 exercises).
files.workbook-item-review-queue.jsonl: Global per-exercise review queue; lessons 1–5 include normalized prompt and answer fields and direct content_record_ref links.

item_level_content_fields.prompt.instruction_pl: Printed Polish instruction transcribed from workbook scan.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.content_pl: Exercise stimulus and response slots in readable Polish.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.page_ocr_ref: Reference to the raw OCR page record.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.visual_dependency: Indicates a source illustration must be included/cropped for the interactive activity.
item_level_content_fields.answer.text: Printed key response(s), structured as strings, arrays, or objects to preserve grouping.
item_level_content_fields.answer.status: Transcription and scan-review state; anomalies are called out rather than silently corrected.
item_level_content_fields.audio_assets: Array of relative audio-file paths explicitly mapped to the exercise.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.interaction_type: Stable task-family label for interactive renderer selection.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.requires_audio: Boolean; true when one or more audio_assets are linked.
item_level_content_fields.prompt.requires_visual: Boolean; true when the activity depends on a workbook illustration.
